answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before trading, with privileges tied to reputation earned only through completed, peer-verified work. A new identity starts at the nadir: no credit, no large deals, only small audited jobs. Each success moves it along a slow voyage of verified service toward the summit of full trading rights. A Sybil attacker must fund a bond and repeat that costly climb for every fake identity, while misbehavior slashes the bond and resets progress, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds and voyages.
